info.name: MoreTables API
info.description: Full v1 API. Variables: baseUrl; token (guest or staff Bearer); challenge_token (guest OTP flow / staff 2FA); admin_challenge_token + admin_token (admin flow). Mailgun: mailgun_api_key, mailgun_domain, mailgun_endpoint for folder 00. IDs are placeholders. Public and authenticated endpoints may return HTTP 429 when rate limits are exceeded; retry with backoff. Reservation availability is live. Reservation writes enforce recurring hours and date-specific special-day overrides, returning HTTP 422 when a requested time is outside effective booking hours or availability changes during processing.

variable.description: Guest: from auth/start. Staff: from auth/staff/login.
Mailgun private API key (Basic: user api, password = key)
Discovery section slug, e.g. top-booked, top-viewed, top-saved, highly-rated, new-on-moretables, featured

item.name: Front of House Backend Integration
item.description: Staff OTP resend, authenticated Reverb authorization, service periods, table availability, removed reservations, dining stages, waitlist cancellation, and shift-note contracts.

item.name: 00 - Mailgun (direct API)
item.description: Send a test message through Mailgun to confirm DNS and keys before relying on app OTP email (Guest Start). Does not hit MoreTables API.

urlencoded.value: If you receive this, Mailgun outbound works.

request.description: POST /v3/{domain}/messages. Use same domain as MAILGUN_DOMAIN in Laravel.
GuestStartRequest: email required. Response includes challenge_token — copy to collection variable challenge_token.
VerifyChallengeRequest: challenge_token (uuid), code (4 digits), device_name optional (max 100). Copy token from response to variable token.
ResendChallengeRequest: challenge_token (uuid) from auth/start.
SocialLoginRequest: id_token required. Optional: device_name, first_name, last_name.
SocialLoginRequest: same as Google — id_token required; optional device_name, first_name, last_name.
StaffLoginRequest: identifier (email or username string) + password. Returns challenge_token.
VerifyChallengeRequest: challenge_token from staff login, code (4 digits), device_name optional.
Change the authenticated merchant staff user's password. Requires correct current_password and merchant staff role.
ForgotPasswordRequest: email required.
ResetPasswordRequest: token (from email), email, password + password_confirmation (Laravel Password defaults).
GuestCompleteProfileRequest: first_name, last_name, phone (unique per user). Bearer token from verify-otp.
Fetch the authenticated user's profile settings for the web settings screen.
Update the authenticated user's profile settings. Supports first_name, last_name, bio, and birthday.

item.name: List restaurants
item.description: Public restaurant listing. Only active restaurants with an active or trialing merchant subscription (current billing period not expired) are returned. Response includes hours summarized from preferred meal schedules (earliest opens_at to latest closes_at per day, falling back to legacy hours).

request.description: Typeahead search suggestions grouped by locations, restaurants, and cuisines. Only publicly listed restaurants (active with active or trialing merchant subscription) appear in restaurant and location results.

item.name: Show restaurant
item.description: Public restaurant detail response including hours summarized from preferred meal schedules (earliest opens_at to latest closes_at per day, falling back to legacy hours), meal_types / meal_schedules for business hours, summary, and discovery_metrics with reviews_count, average_rating, ratings_breakdown (counts keyed 5–1), and category_breakdown (food, service, ambience, value averages). Returns 404 when the restaurant is inactive or does not have an active or trialing merchant subscription.

query.description: Optional earliest slot time (H:i). When provided, returns slots starting at or after this time on the requested date.

request.description: Live reservation availability. Optional time filters slots to those starting at or after the given H:i value on the requested date. Returns 404 when the restaurant is inactive or does not have an active or trialing merchant subscription.

Homepage discovery rails for mobile and web. Only active restaurants with an active or trialing merchant subscription appear. Each restaurant includes reservation_times for the requested date and party size when tables are available.
Paginated view for a single discovery section. Only publicly listed restaurants appear. Each restaurant includes reservation_times for the requested date and party size when tables are available.
Public list of cuisine options for restaurant onboarding and filters.

Public reviews from publicly listed restaurants (active with active or trialing merchant subscription), ordered by highest rating first, with rating, nullable notes, customer name, and restaurant name. Within the same rating, order is random.

Tracks restaurant detail views used for Top Viewed discovery ranking. Repeated views from the same user, session ID, or IP within 30 minutes return HTTP 200 with deduplicated=true and do not create another row. This endpoint may return HTTP 429.
Public review feed with pagination links, summary (reviews_count, average_rating, ratings_breakdown, category_breakdown for food/service/ambience/value), and presentation-ready reviewer details.

Public list of published Moretable Lineup blog posts. Pass latitude & longitude to show experiences near the diner, ordered nearest first; each item then includes distance_km. radius_km defaults to 25.
Public detail of a published Moretable Lineup blog post by slug.
Current lifetime loyalty points, current tier, next tier, and tier thresholds.

Paginated reward point ledger: earn (credit) with restaurant/reservation source and expires_at; redeem (debit) with credit_value/credit_currency and consumed lots; expire (debit) when points pass their 1-year validity.

Redeem a configured tier of lifetime points for restaurant credit. Points must match an active redemption tier (see GET me/rewards/status). Returns the debit transaction with credit value and FIFO consumption details.

request.description: Availability is checked live inside a restaurant-scoped lock. Retry HTTP 422 validation responses when availability changes during processing.
OpenTable-style "Notify me" alerts. Returns the authenticated guest's active table-availability alerts.

Watch a restaurant for a table matching party size, date, and time window. When a table opens the guest is notified via push, email, and (when whatsapp_updates is true and the guest has SMS/WhatsApp alerts enabled) WhatsApp. Returns HTTP 201 for a new alert, or HTTP 200 with the existing alert if an identical active alert already exists.
Add additional guests to the reservation.

Sends an in-app + push notification broadcast to the restaurant's guests. audience is 'all' (every user with an active or completed reservation) or 'selected' (only users linked to the provided guest_contact_ids, which come from the merchant guests endpoint). No WhatsApp or email is sent.

item.name: Special Days
item.description: Special days override recurring availability for one restaurant date. Closed special days expose no booking slots. Open special days require at least one non-overlapping shift. Reservation writes enforce these overrides and return HTTP 422 for invalid times.

item.name: Weekly Shifts
item.description: Weekly recurring shifts define booking windows, turn times, table availability, turn controls, and flow settings for each day of the week. Shifts are seeded once from onboarding business hours when a restaurant has no shifts yet.

Create a custom reward-point rule. Omit or empty `times` to award the points all day on the selected days. `days` are 0=Sunday..6=Saturday.

Delete a reward-point rule.
